SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2024,
between Alpha LLC ("Provider") and Beta Corp ("Client").

1. SERVICES
   Provider agrees to deliver software consulting services as described in Schedule A.

2. TERM
   Start Date: March 1, 2024
   End Date: August 31, 2024

3. COMPENSATION
   Client shall pay Provider $15,000 per month, due on the 1st of each month.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
   Both parties agree to keep all proprietary information confidential.

5. GOVERNING LAW
   This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
